ioc-probe.description: IOC CAN channel probe — maps /dev/ipc/ioc interface, captures CAN bus data, dumps persistence addresses and factory ESD files. Replaces NDR probe.

sysinfo.description: Full system dump: takes several minutes, so wait for DONE on the screen before pulling the stick (each finished section is listed in pcm_ran.txt, so an early pull shows how far it got). For a quick VIN and activation check, use the USB Stick tab's Diagnostic mode instead. Comprehensive PCM 3.1 diagnostic. Captures the system log (full + severity-filtered) with boot sequence, boot gates, errors and amplifier detection; the crash record; storage map with partition tables and drive geometry; amplifier resolution (which sound profile is actually live, and whether it matches the flag); odometer and vehicle data; activation codes; software identity and update history; service manager and listening ports; a full restorable /HBpersistence backup; plus the hardware/IPC/CAN/DSI device-tree probe. Read-only -- nothing on the car is modified. Also dumps the DSI service registry from /srv/servicebroker -- the broker's entire live list of registered interfaces and their versions, which no devctl can enumerate -- and the Bluetooth bring-up chain (serfpga, phone-db gate, scp_pss, address-book size, boot-hook and trace-profile presence), which is what determines whether the unit can pick Bluetooth at startup at all.

telnet.description: Root shell via telnet (port 23) and raw ksh (port 2323). PCM /etc/ is read-only — session-only, re-run after reboot.

usb-net.description: Universal ASIX USB-Ethernet driver for PCM 3.1 / MMI3G+ / RNS-850. Supports AX88772 / 772A / 772B / 772C (and 88178 + Linksys/NetGear rebadges) by activating Harman's own AX88772B init path from later firmware. Brings up the link, gets DHCP (or static), and enables telnet. Loads from USB only — never modifies the read-only firmware.
